text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday. A line of students had formed 
in front of the academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is some kind of event going on?" Thinking 
so, I followed the line to the front, and—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —Here, it is ready.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Even when you move, you don't mind it 
at all... You really are incredible.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: These impenetrable braids...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you didn't know? Ikuno-san is pretty 
famous in the braid community.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's why so many students come here to 
get their hair braided like this, and—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hairdressers come here to study, too, ya 
know!☆

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I am honored.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Those skills are personally 
certified by this Class President!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Braids that never come undone, no matter 
how Bakushin your actions are at the 
event!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A-N-D!! Just by lightly combing through 
it—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The next day, my hair was perfectly 
straight!!!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm braiding it loosely so it won't leave 
any harsh creases in your hair.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I-It's been a huge help to me because of 
how stable it is!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even on days with terrible bedhead, 
Ikuno-san fixes it up in a jiffy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can focus on training 
without having to worry about my hair!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
A hairstyle is also part of the body. A 
factor that heavily influences one's 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: That is why I attained it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No matter the bedhead. Whether it's humid 
or dry—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The technique to maintain the exact same 
braid!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think there was such a deep reason for 
maintaining her hairstyle! Which means—
choice_data_list:
Is there a special reason you're so 
particular about your braids?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Because it's cute.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: No, that's why... ...Um.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
They're cute, so I like them. Braids, that 
is.
choice_data_list: It's not just theory, that's nice, huh

It's not just theory, that's nice, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
They're cute, so I like them. Braids, that 
is.
choice_data_list: It's not just theory, that's nice, huh

It's not just theory, that's nice, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Heh, exactly. Maintaining motivation is 
important too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I see~. So that's why every time you 
finish... you always tell me, "You look 
cute~".

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, honestly, being happy about that 
was part of why I came...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it suits everyone so well. It makes 
braiding them so much fun for me too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hairstyles... Nay, it was a moment where 
one realized the profound depths of 
braids.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
! Really? I had no idea you were a fan of 
braids too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Um, since when did you take a liking to 
braids?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"My mother knitted this for me. I always 
loved chatting with her while she 
knitted――"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I'm so sorry. There are people waiting 
in line, and I just...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all! In fact, I'd love for 
you to knit it while telling me that 
story.
